verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jira has saved searches, though one user calls creating a useful one painful, and users value JQL as the query language behind filtered views. No first-party documentation covers saving filters, and nothing shows sharing a saved view by link. missing for 10: first-party docs on saved filters, evidence of link-based sharing or share permissions, hands-on corroboration of the full save-and-share flow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link

citations.quote: create a useful saved search in JIRA
JQL (Jira Query Language)? That's what I appreciate most about Jira.
